item.name: Login (Web,Cloud,DevEnv)
MagoWeb 5.0 (Mw-Console)
item.description:
Starting from version 5.0 of **Magoweb**, the gwamUrl will no longer be used for logging in.  
**mw-console** will be the new service for handling login requests and authentication.

A partire dalla versione 5.0 di **Magoweb**, gwamUrl non verrà più utilizzato per l'accesso. **mw-console** sarà il nuovo servizio per la gestione delle richieste di accesso e autenticazione.

As previously stated, it is not possible to access MagoCloud without authenticating into the system. For this purpose, the following methods are exposed:

- Login: Allows users to authenticate using specific username, password, and subscription. The user used must have been associated with the subscription through the provisioning system. If specific parts of the product are accessed that are subject to specific roles, the user must be equipped with those roles. The login operation will return an authentication token.
    
- IsValidToken: Checks the validity of a specific authentication token obtained previously from a Login operation.
    
- Logoff: Disconnects the authenticated user from a previous Login operation.

item.name: TbServer
item.description:
The TbServerGate microservice exposes the possibility to menage business objects  
based on MagicLink desktop technology.

item.name: WebMethods
item.description: The TbServerGate microservice exposes the possibility to access TbWebMethods (previously SOAP/WCF) via Rest.

item.name: DataService
item.description:
The DataService microservice exposes the possibility of extracting data that are defined through  
standard and custom xml contained in the reference objects folder.  
It then allows you to extract the data defined by a hotlink or radar query.

item.name: DMSService
item.description:
The DMS (Document Management System) it allows for storing, sharing,and managing electronic documents.  
Is a solution for digital document management.

item.name: ReportingService
item.description:
The ReportingServices microservice exposes the possibility of launching a report and obtaining the extracted data.  
The microservice supports both Xml and Json format.

item.name: Lock DataManager
item.description: The lock action corresponds to writing a record in the TB_Locks table for each locked data item, while the unlock action corresponds to removing the record from this table.
